scenarios.description: Zero client read downtime; RS(20,12) decodes seamlessly from surviving 19 nodes.
Inline decoding from 12 surviving shards achieves RPO=0 and RTO=0.
Quorum election elects new leader in ~350ms; synchronous WAL prevents data loss.
Node scans local WAL and rebuilds shard index in ~12ms.
Fail-closed in <1ms returning InsufficientValidShards without corrupted data leakage.
